close_reason: Round 1 complete: all P0/P1/P2 fixed; 26 P3/P4 items deferred to round 2
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — 12 findings: undocumented invariants required of all future backend implementors (VacationResponse upsert idempotency, batch destroy, size placeholder, structured header form nulls), identity sub-path immutability bypass, test infrastructure that silently truncates and uses a divergent parser from production, and a fragile global ID counter.
Confidence: 85% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: JMAP-bx3z.41 (apply_header_form silent null — validate_header_form accepts the forms as valid but the handler silently returns null; this is a real data-loss path but could be argued as documented stub behavior), JMAP-bx3z.3 (apply_header_form returns null for structured forms — P1, same root as .41), JMAP-bx3z.30 (Mailbox role uniqueness: role is free-form string but uniqueness check uses created map — the combined create+update within one request interaction needs more review). Uncertainty driven by: could not see runtime test coverage data (which handlers have integration tests exercising the null-return path in apply_header_form); could not check whether the MemoryBackend query_changes stub causes any existing conformance_* tests to silently pass without exercising the real logic. Would raise confidence if: full test coverage report was visible (lcov/tarpaulin output), and if apply_header_form null-return paths were covered by tests that assert on the null or on an eventual implementation.
